Full assigned prefix permits finite exact occurrence/pair enumeration; no full syntax carrier enumeration is claimed.

outcomes.NON_IMP_ASSIGNED_PREFIX_COVER: Only when output has an assigned canonical literal NON-imp formula C and every earlier output has an assigned canonical literal formula. Enumerate every named AX matching C, each indexed Gamma occurrence matching C, every prior-row UG occurrence licensed by original parameters/Gamma with output C, and every ordered earlier MP pair including repeated rows. Full validity/legality filtering is mandatory and unfinished checks propagate. Complete proposal binds full state/exclusions/binding and carries all matching survivors/rejection observations and complete row/pair census. No UI/EqSubst case can output non-imp C.
outcomes.TWO_LEGAL_WITNESSES: Exactly two distinct whole-state-legal incident candidates, full keys/prototypes/membership receipts/t/m/read obligations. This is an untrusted positive lower-bound proposal, no exact degree/cardinality/graph claim.
outcomes.UNKNOWN: Any other query whose hint list yields fewer than two legal candidates. A zero/one shortlist is never a dead/forced claim. Missing marks are not zero, and malformed state/mark/type or unfinished membership does not fabricate cover.

private_state.excluded: List of full key records {tile_type_id,type_preimage,translation}, unique/disjoint selected. These are provided branch-local exclusions, not proved by this component. Caller must authenticate their justification/context/lifecycle; no global exclusion learned here.
private_state.generation: Complete24 root point entries [[0,row],0]. This fixed target activates all obligations at root0, so every selected unit tile has growth generation1. No other/growing target or generalized generation model is claimed.
private_state.m: Every assigned marking point/value including original fixed boundary and all selected marks; absence by dictionary membership, never truthiness. Profile emits tagged formula/offset/outside values. Arbitrary bare zero markings are outside this exact profile rather than interpreted as absent.
private_state.retention: Response retains full private state value, canonical SHA, current binding and query. It mutates no input and provides no engine cache/rollback implementation.
private_state.selected: List of exact full key records {tile_type_id,type_preimage,translation,generation:1}. Type preimage has input_epoch,primitive_witness,ordered_premise_formulas,ordered_offsets. No digest-only authority. Full primitive membership and exact rows/marks reconstructed.
private_state.t: Complete24 pairs [integer point [0,row],literal int total0or1], no missing target row/duplicate/bool.
private_state.validation: Clone exact builtin tree; rebuild original outside sentinel at channel1 negative rows and exact target at last row, all selected primitive prototypes/support/marks; reject if full provided t/m differs. Selected keys once, exclusion keys exact, complete preimages/collision detection, incompatible duplicate marks or overfill reject. Query must be an unfilled required row.
